candidates.title: Postpone account sign in after pet selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step after users pick their pet and create the adoption certificate, reducing initial drop-off.
candidates.why: 72.9% sign_in conversion with a 567s mean time indicates users are stalled by upfront authentication before committing to a pet.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Postponing sign-in builds pet investment before auth, targeting 27.1% sign-in drop-off.

candidates.title: Desktop pet placement diagnostic screen
candidates.change: Insert a short desktop visibility verification screen right after the waiting stage to ensure the pet rendered on screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or app not opening, contributing to high wait/finish times.

new_desktop_check.headline: Confirm Desktop Visibility
new_desktop_check.body: Your pet should now appear floating on your desktop screen. Click to confirm.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens shows negative lift in prior tests (-0.8%) despite support email evidence.

candidates.title: Split account sign in screen with account persistence guarantee
candidates.change: Redesign sign_in screen to split layout featuring a dedicated reminder about log-in account matching.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different or fresh account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Companion
sign_in.body: Use your primary account so your pet state and preferences stay synced safely.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and funnel drop-off, but requires screen redesign.

candidates.title: Custom pet generation retry flow
candidates.change: Add an instant preset fallback option inside the pet selection flow if photo processing stalls or custom rendering fails.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9%.

pick_friend.hint: If custom generation takes too long, pick from standard pet presets at any time.

guard.reason: Adding a preset fallback option during pet selection is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest converting step (60.9%) backed by 3 support emails reporting creation failures.

candidates.title: Account recovery notice on sign in screen
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint below the sign-in options reminding users to sign in with their existing account to restore pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets due to signing into duplicate accounts.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to instantly load your existing pet.

guard.reason: Adding account recovery guidance hints on the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Very low cost text hint addressing top support issue (8 emails) on account confusion.

candidates.title: Estimated wait time counter and status updates
candidates.change: Show dynamic time estimates and live status steps while waiting for pet generation to complete.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off during background generation.

guard.reason: Displaying progress and dynamic estimates during a real wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles massive wait times (mean 2336s) during generation step.

candidates.title: Interactive control overview on home intro
candidates.change: Display an active desktop notification on home_intro explaining basic pet interactions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned confusion on how to control, hide, or speak to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Click and drag your desktop pet to move it, or right-click to open pet controls.

guard.reason: Adding control hints to the home intro overlay is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Resolves user confusion reported in 3 support emails at finish step (64.8% conversion).

candidates.title: Story scroll overview redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen into a story scroll layout highlighting core app capabilities before pathway selection.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path with a 514s mean time suggests users spend significant time deciding without clear context.

story.headline: Meet Your New Virtual Desktop Buddy
story.body: Adopt, customize, and interact with an animated pet right on your computer screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving its job is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation, but full redesign is expensive.

candidates.title: Card layout for adoption certificate stage
candidates.change: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a card layout with step counters to emphasize creation progress.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and a high mean time of 1017s.

guard.reason: Switching adoption certificate to a card layout while maintaining the official certificate function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact by focusing on adoption (lowest funnel step at 60.9%), but funnel-only evidence.

candidates.title: Photo formatting guidance hint
candidates.change: Add explicit photo lighting and framing guidance text on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures and distortion when generating from photos.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward with minimal background noise.

held_by_harm_budget: Split account sign in screen with account persistence guarantee
Interactive control overview on home intro
Estimated wait time counter and status updates
